title: Figure 11: Object Sightings by Reported Color of Object with Evaluation Distribution
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with one bar for each reported object color group: White (23.5%), Metallic (17.7%), Not stated (12.3%), Orange (10.0%), Red (8.1%) and Other (28.4%). Each bar is split into hatched evaluation segments labeled Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other and Unknown, and the y-axis is "Per Cent". Caption: "FIGURE 11 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY REPORTED COLORS OF OBJECT(S) WITH EVALUATION DISTRIBUTION FOR EACH COLOR GROUP"; drawing A-7489, page 27.
